messages.subject: Configuring Memory Error
parts:
I am getting an error when trying to configure the memory:

> shinyapps::configureApp("chicrime",size="medium",redeploy=TRUE)
Error: /v1/applications/11201/properties/containers.template 404 - Invalid property: containers.template.

I have tried terminating and redeploying the app and it didn't make a difference.
I am on the latest version of shiny apps, 0.3.4

This app was deployed to another account.  However, I did terminate and remove that account.
That is the only thing different that I can think of that might have affected this.
The deployment of the app appears to go find. I can see my app running (but it fails quickly because of memory limits).

Thanks

rajiv

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Configuring Memory Error
parts:
Folks,

There was a compatibility problem with the shinyapps package that I've now resolved. If you are seeing an error when you run configureApp(), please update to the latest version of the shinyapps package from GitHub:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')


Please let me know if you are still seeing issues running configureApp()

Thanks!
-Andy
